exposure: Preterm birth before 23 weeks of gestation
cohort: 2,865 live births occurring between 16 and 22 weeks of gestation in Ohio from 2006-2015
finding: Nearly 1 in 10 live births at less than 23 weeks were delivered by cesarean, with increasing parity, increasing birth weight, maternal corticosteroid administration, and fetal malpresentation being associated with previable CD.
mod_finding: Nearly 1 out of 10 births during the previable period was delivered via cesarean.
